compositor_halts.topic: Utility fault current + transformer impedance — DERIVED, not confirmed
compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: utility available fault current and the utility transformer nameplate were not provided. Derived on a worst-case basis: 500 kVA pad-mount (FLA 601 A), %Z 4.35 less the IEEE C57.12.00 -7.5% tolerance = 4.02%, infinite primary bus: 601 A / 0.0402 = 14,960 A sym, so 22 kAIC. X/R 5.5 assumed (no utility data). No motor contribution. The utility letter and transformer nameplate must confirm before AIC ratings are released for procurement.
compositor_halts.blocks: AIC ratings released for procurement · DV-4 bus bracing verified against utility data

compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: no connected-load or panel schedule exists (T3-EOR). The 600 A service is an NEC 220 area-based estimate (290.2 kVA calculated, 349 A at 480 V, +25% growth = 436 A) built on assumed receptacle, HVAC, kitchen and laundry densities; every panel rating is a Tier-2 default. Live feeder trips total 835 A on the 600 A bus (diversity).
compositor_halts.blocks: Service-size verification · panel schedules · feeder sizing confirmation

compositor_halts.topic: Generator breaker, feeder and capacity — Tier-3 values FILLED by compositor
compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: generator feeder sizing is EOR input with no schedule lookup (NEC 445.13). The compositor FILLED: 200 kW / 250 kVA at 0.8 PF, FLA 300.7 A, against an estimated 128 kVA standby load (700 ~15 kVA, 701 ~22.5 kVA, 702 ~90 kVA) sized up for motor starting; integral breaker 400AF/350AT LSI (>=115% FLA); feeder on feeder_schedule tag 4004, (2) 3"C - (4)350 AL + #3 CU GND. Aggregate ATS ratings 350 A exceed the generator FLA — acceptable only with load diversity and 702 load shed (NEC 700.4(B) / 702.4). The generator sizing study is owed.
compositor_halts.blocks: Generator feeder release · generator sizing study · EM board main rating

compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: X"d 0.12 pu assumed (worst case, low end of the typical 0.12-0.18 range) for the emergency-source fault current: 300.7 A / 0.12 = 2,506 A sym on the EM bus. Generator submittal data must confirm before the EM board 10 kAIC rating is released.
compositor_halts.blocks: EM board AIC release · ATS emergency-side withstand verification

compositor_halts.topic: Unplaced rooms in the architectural model
compositor_halts.text: COMPOSITOR_HALT: two harvested rooms are unplaced in the Revit model and carry 0 SF — 200 MECHANICAL ELECTRICAL and 238 GENERAL STORAGE. They are excluded from the 18,862 SF basis, so the NEC 220 area load calculation (and the 600 A service derived from it) may be understated. The architect must place or delete them.

compositor_notes.text: 600 A, 480Y/277V, 3 phase 4 wire. Owner supplied no electrical scope: NEC 220 area-based calculation 290.2 kVA -> 349 A at 480 V, +25% growth = 436 A -> next standard size 600 A (NEC 240.6(A)); 26.4 VA/SF on 18,862 SF. Service lateral feeder_schedule tag 6004.

Veterinary clinic for cats, 18,862 SF, one storey (Level 1). NEC 517 covers human health-care facilities only, so the standby system is laid out as true Article 700 (egress lighting, fire alarm, egress hardware), 701 (domestic water booster, sewage ejector) and 702 (animal-housing HVAC, refrigeration, IT) classes, one ATS each. Single storey: no A-7 level lines, no riser cascades.

Main MAIN-CB 800AF/600AT LSI. GFP of equipment is not required: NEC 230.95 applies to services of 1000 A and above. Normal-side feeder breakers are thermal-magnetic (TM); no second-level GFP (NEC 517.17 does not apply). N-G bond at the service (NEC 250.24(C)) and utility meter as standard.

compositor_notes.topic: Branch architecture — 480 V panels ahead of the step-downs
compositor_notes.text: The plug, mechanical, 700 and 702 branches are drawn as 480Y/277V MLO panels (4P-1-A, 4M-1-A, E4L-1-A, O4M-1-A) whose internal breakers feed the step-downs at the transformer-schedule primary OCPD (125 A for 75 kVA, 70 A for 45 kVA, 50 A for 30 kVA, NEC 450.3(B)). The kitchen/laundry 75 kVA unit (4T-1-C) is fed directly from the switchboard (CB-04, 125 A primary OCPD).

compositor_notes.topic: Worst-case impedance basis for fault current
compositor_notes.text: Every dry-type unit uses percent_z.low / x_over_r.low from transformer_impedance_V1_0_0.json on an infinite primary bus: 75 kVA 208.2 A / 0.044 = 4,731 A; 45 kVA 124.9 A / 0.034 = 3,674 A; 30 kVA 83.3 A / 0.023 = 3,620 A. Correct bound for AIC; wrong one for voltage drop.

Every dry-type secondary OCPD is the main of the panel it feeds (250 A for 75 kVA, 150 A for 45 kVA, 100 A for 30 kVA — transformer-schedule lookups), protecting the secondary conductors. Hence MCB on those panels. 2P-1-B, fed through from 2P-1-A, is MLO.

compositor_notes.topic: Emergency architecture and EM board main
compositor_notes.text: Golden-case pattern: generator-fed EM switchboard E4MSB-1-A (400 A, 10 kAIC, two-level with a 400AF/350AT LSI main). Its breakers feed the ATS emergency (source 2) inputs; normal (source 1) inputs come from 4MSB-1-A (CB-05/06/07). The NEC 700 breaker ECB-01 sits in its own section (NEC 700.10(B)); 701 and 702 in their own sections, ordered 700 -> 701 -> 702.

E4A-1-A 100 A (NEC 700), L4A-1-A 100 A (NEC 701), O4A-1-A 150 A (NEC 702, manual-reset load shed), 3-pole with solid neutral (generator is not a separately derived system — no EM-side N-G bond), 22 kA withstand >= 14.96 kA available.
Two 100 A / 3P spares and two spaces on 4MSB-1-A; one 100 A / 3P spare and one space on E4MSB-1-A.
